name: Series-reactor primary path reference
summary: Identifies the reactor inserted in the assigned main power-current path.
description: Identifies the reactor inserted in the assigned main power-current path. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Incoming primary current” at the input and “Series-reactor outgoing path” at the output. Its role differs from a shunt-connected reactor.

Read the connected power path before interpreting a secondary output or alarm. These original educational component references provide no product dimensions, dielectric rating, installation clearance or construction approval. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
readingNotes: Start at the named input: Incoming primary current. Identify its source device or document and the state represented on the drawing.
Follow the named output: Series-reactor outgoing path. Cross-reference its destination and separate the command from confirmation that the equipment responded.
